updates.title: The $228 Million Moon Suit Prada Helped Design
updates.subtitle: NASA outsourced the most iconic garment in human exploration to a fashion house and a startup. Here's what that looks like.
updates.summary: For the first time ever, NASA astronauts will walk on the Moon in a privately-built spacesuit — co-designed by Italian fashion house Prada.
updates.author: Joachim Gresslien

updates.title: The Moon Landing That Needs 12 Refueling Flights
updates.subtitle: Before any Artemis III astronaut even leaves Earth, SpaceX must solve an orbital refueling problem no one has ever attempted. The stakes could not be higher.
updates.summary: Exclusive deep dive: why NASA's safety panel, the Inspector General, and a former administrator all think Artemis III could be years late.
updates.author: Joachim Gresslien

updates.title: 6 Things NASA Just Figured Out About Going to the Moon
updates.subtitle: The post-flight data from Artemis II is in — and some of the findings surprised even the engineers who designed the hardware.
updates.summary: Thermal margins exceeded predictions. Astronauts adapted faster than Apollo crews. And one engineering fix worked better than expected. Inside the Artemis II debrief.
updates.author: Joachim Gresslien

updates.title: Relive the Mission That Made History
updates.subtitle: Ten days, four astronauts, and humanity's first crewed trip beyond Earth orbit since 1972 — all in pictures, video, and the full NASA recap.
updates.summary: The visual recap of Artemis II — launch, lunar flyby, Earth rise, and splashdown. Includes NASA's official 3-minute mission summary.
updates.author: Joachim Gresslien
